name: Almond Cherry Lavender Crunch
instructions: Put butter , honey and lavender in a medium saucepan and warm over medium heat
Once the butter has melted , turn off heat , stir mixture and let it steep for 10 minutes
Line a shallow sided sheet pan with wax paper or parchment
Add the rolled oats , cherries , almonds and salt to butter mixture and stir well
Spread mixture evenly on the sheet pan
Bake 20-30 minutes , until golden brown , stirring at least once or twice to ensure even browning
Store airtight for up to 1 week
